membership.use: Corroborate dated additions and deletions; an announcement sample is not a complete historical baseline.

spot_check.use: SMCI/DECK replace WHR/ZION before trading on 2024-03-18; both saved candidates match the before/after check.

prices.use: Explicit raw adjustment, feed and asof identity policy; paginate all responses. Default current-day symbol mapping can relabel historical bars.

actions.use: Queries use process dates; the provider warns of availability delays. Exhausted pagination and complete response filtering do not establish historical coverage.

context.use: Public filings and company facts can support dated facts. They do not establish a historically announced future earnings calendar or historical GICS sector classification.

methodology: Use saved source files recovered 2026-09-07, preserving their hashes and cutoff dates; these are snapshots, not a claim about current repository contents.
Compare only identical snapshot dates from 2012 onward after uppercase and dot-to-hyphen normalization; exclude duplicate dates in the second source. Do not merge, repair or approve disagreements.

Count NYSE sessions from 2012-01-01 through the last completed session 2026-09-04. Convert bar timestamps to New York session dates. Check duplicates, OHLC bounds, positive prices and nonnegative volume.
Conduct read-only authenticated source capability probes with existing access; no subscription purchased. Store raw responses privately, publish only summaries and hashes.
Check one official membership event before and after its effective date. This does not prove source independence or full historical accuracy.
limitations: Missing inactive-audit symbols are not automatically missing S&P constituents; first establish universe eligibility and company identity.
The candidate count of 324 removed symbols does not distinguish index removal from bankruptcy or delisting.
SIVB probe returns seven pre-halt sessions ending 2023-03-09; post-halt valuation and terminal recovery remain unverified.
No verified free source for the entire required 2012-onward price/action/context history has been established.
Do not shorten the existing period, substitute current constituents, synthesize unavailable prices or fill context using future facts.
